annotations.text: Search ideation — three directions for the Explore tab (item 9, rulings in readme §13 / Q46). Every direction shows: rest (recents + the orbit entry) and searching (kinds, order swap + seen toggle, ranked rows with viewer-relative ranks, the seam, the aged tail, @/# scope operators with two-line indirect hits). They differ in WHERE the orbit lives and HOW kinds are filtered: 1 · orbit as hero card, kinds as a chips row. 2 · field first, orbit docked above the bar, filters as one worded trigger + sheet. 3 · two equal rooms, results sectioned by kind instead of filtered.

The operators: "@sol salt" scopes to @sol's acts — direct hits match their own content's name; INDIRECT hits match the act's target (the comment found through its post, the offer through its item) and say so on the second line. "#saltmaps <text>" scopes to tagged content the same way.

The seam: above it, rows carry the viewer-relative rank (quiet numbers, drill-down waits for item 13). Below it, nothing is rankable from this vantage — rows carry their age instead, relative to a year, absolute past it.
